corpus: SYNTHETIC DEMO PROTOCOL (illustrative only). Give acetaminophen 15 mg/kg PO every 4 to 6 hours. The maximum daily acetaminophen total is 75 mg/kg. Give ibuprofen 10 mg/kg PO every 6 hours for children over 6 months. The maximum daily ibuprofen total is 40 mg/kg. Give amoxicillin 45 mg/kg PO divided every 12 hours. Ondansetron is dosed at 0.15 mg/kg IV. Escalate to the on-call physician when respiratory rate exceeds 60 breaths per minute. Escalate when oxygen saturation falls below 92 percent. Begin fluid resuscitation at 20 ml/kg over 1 hour. Record a temperature above 38 degrees celsius as fever. Epinephrine for anaphylaxis is 0.01 mg/kg IM. The observation period after epinephrine is 4 hours.
